ruleset.name: baton-sensors
ruleset.description: Complexity and forbidden-pattern sensors (core, Java/Spring). Project invariants go in profile/sensors/. Thresholds live here and in stack.md; change both. Every rule's message carries REMEDIATION: and reaches target/pmd.xml and the console.

rule.message: Too many branches. REMEDIATION: extract the branches into named methods
Hard to follow. REMEDIATION: flatten with guard clauses and extract named methods
Too many paths. REMEDIATION: split the method so each part can be tested alone
Too many parameters. REMEDIATION: group the related parameters into a record
God class. REMEDIATION: split it along its responsibilities
Too many collaborators. REMEDIATION: split the class or depend on a narrower port
Too many methods. REMEDIATION: split the class along its responsibilities
Catch-all. REMEDIATION: catch the specific exception this code can handle
Swallowed exception. REMEDIATION: handle it, or let it reach the edge mapping
Reassigned parameter. REMEDIATION: use a new local variable
Mutable static state. REMEDIATION: make it final, or move the state into an instance
Unused private method. REMEDIATION: delete it
Unused private field. REMEDIATION: delete it

rule.name: NoFieldInjection
rule.message: Field injection (stack.md: constructor injection only). REMEDIATION: remove @Autowired from the field; take the dependency as a final field set in the constructor

rule.name: NoLogicInController
rule.message: Business logic in a controller. REMEDIATION: move the branch, loop or arithmetic into a service method and call that one method
rule.description: A controller method holds no branch, loop or arithmetic.
